Parish of Saul & Ballee Mini Christmas Fair Saturday 12th December (after 5pm Mass) & Sunday 13th December (after 9.30am Mass) in the meeting rooms, Parochial house, Saul. Cake stall, Tombola, Handmade Christmas Craft items, Handmade Wreaths . There will be a small raffle which will be drawn at the end of the fair on Sunday 13th December. All proceeds from the fair and raffle will go towards heating our Churches over the winter months. Everyone welcome! Please note this is cash only – unfortunately there are no facilities for card payment. We need donations of small value, new/unused items for our tombola. We will also need donations of cakes/buns/traybakes/biscuits etc to sell on our cake stall. If you can spare a couple of hours to help setup, help out on one of the stalls or help clear up please contact the Parish office. Fountain Foodbank Annual Christmas Appeal Once again this Christmas, Fountain Foodbank is asking for your support and generosity for those in need in our community. On each of the coming four weekends of Advent you are asked to please consider bringing an item or items of NON-PERISHABLE food for use in food parcels to be distributed before Christmas to those in need in our parish and wider local community. Items of non-perishable food that are sought include tins of beans, soup, tuna, fruit, spaghetti, ham, corned beef, meals/pies, peas, carrots, sweetcorn and cooking sauces. In addition, boxes of cereal, teabags, coffee as well as packets of biscuits, pasta and rice are very welcome. Toiletries and cleaning products are also sought by the Foodbank. All donations, no matter how small, make a difference to those in food poverty. Throughout Advent a large, marked donation box will be available in Strangford and Kilclief churches. Donations from Saul & Ballee can be left in the Church or the Parish office (during office hours) . Thank you in advance for your support and generosity!
